description: October 10 birthday meaning: Libra decan 2, birthday number 1, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, an October 10 birthday falls in Libra, in the second decan, with Venus as the sign's ruler and Uranus as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 1. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Libra is cardinal and air.

sections.heading: The October 10 birthday in astrology
paragraphs: Ten becomes 1 in numerology, so the 10th of October pairs Libran diplomacy with a strong independent streak. Sixteen degrees of the sign falls in the second decan, where Uranus adds originality and a dislike of being told what to think. The interpretive result is a charming nonconformist, cooperative in style yet unusually firm about following their own judgement.

Astronomically, October 10 puts the Sun near 16° Libra in most years, inside the second ten-degree slice of the sign, which tradition links with Uranus. The middle stretch of Libra, roughly October 3 to October 13, takes Uranus as sub-ruler, the planet associated with Aquarius in modern astrology. This tends to turn the sign's interest in fairness towards society at large. Natives are often pictured as idealistic, progressive and drawn to groups, networks and causes. Their relationships may be unconventional, or built on friendship and shared values more than tradition. Uranus brings originality and also a cool, detached streak when emotions run high. Combining their sense of justice with personal warmth usually helps them persuade rather than simply be right.

sections.heading: Birthday number and Life Path for October 10
paragraphs: A birthday on the 10th is a compound: 1 + 0 = 1. In Pythagorean numerology this is read as a 1 with a 0 attached, and the 0 is often described as amplifying whatever stands beside it. So the 10th carries the independence and initiative of the 1, with an added sense of potential and of cycles completing and restarting. People born on this day are frequently portrayed as self-reliant and adaptable, able to begin again after setbacks. The day number is secondary to the Life Path, but here it often shows as a quiet, practical resilience.

Add the birth year and the picture shifts again: an October 10 birthday gives Life Path 3 for 1990, 4 for 2000, 5 for 2010 and 6 for 2020. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11. Read the birthday number as a secondary note beside that main theme.

sections.heading: Season, Chinese zodiac and famous October 10 birthdays
paragraphs: October birthdays fall in mid-autumn north of the equator, with turning leaves and earlier evenings, and in mid-spring in the southern hemisphere. Libra holds most of the month, with Scorpio arriving around October 23. In numerology October is month 10, which reduces to 1: a number of new starts and independence, carried here with a 0 that is often read as amplifying it. October 10 is the 283rd day of the year (284th in a leap year). Counting forward, the next sign change, into Scorpio, is usually complete within 14 days, by October 24.

By October 10 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year. Among the best-known people with an October 10 birthday are Fridtjof Nansen (1861), Harold Pinter (1930) and Naoto Kan (1946).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is October 10?
faq.answer: October 10 is Libra in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the second decan of Libra, which tradition links with Uranus.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on October 10?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On October 10 the Life Path is 9 in 1960, 1 in 1970, 11 in 1980, 3 in 1990, 4 in 2000, 5 in 2010 and 6 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 1 for everyone born on the 10th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on October 10?
faq.answer: For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by October 10, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on October 10?
faq.answer: Well-known people born on October 10 include Fridtjof Nansen (1861), Harold Pinter (1930) and Naoto Kan (1946). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
